summary.en: The sheet detents or reels to a line, the line is underlined, and the nearest band repeats it phrase by phrase; headings pin as chapters on the way.
summary.zh: 长卷顿一下或滚一段停到一句话，这句被划线，最近的引语条逐个短语复述它；途中标题吸顶成章节。

fits: Each claim the page makes, read in turn.
notFor: claims that are not on the page; more than four phrases a line.

intent.en: Read the page's claims one at a time, each marked where it is written and said in large type.
intent.zh: 一次读一句页面上的主张：在原处划线，再用大字说出来。

content.en: A mark on the page and its quote in 1–2 lines of phrases (≤ 20 chars each).
content.zh: 页面上的一处标记和它的引语，1–2 行短语（每段 ≤ 6 字）。

fits.zh: 页面上的每一个主张，轮流读。

notFor.zh: 页面上没有的主张；一行超过四个短语。

en: One underline at a time: the previous one retracts or is carried off before the next draws.
zh: 同一时间只有一条下划线：上一条收回或被滚走后，下一条才画。

source.path: film-v1/plan.js SPANS detent1, under2, swap2, reel2, under4; film.js offsetAt, band, underline

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
